coordinate_frame: Original Sionna scene coordinates, metres. Axes as in the OBJ: X and Y are ground plane, Z is height/altitude. Meshes are NOT recentred - real UAV and user coordinates overlay directly.
geometry_honesty_note: The dense modelled urban area lies roughly 400-800 m from the origin. Within +/- 200 m of the origin the mesh has only a few hundred triangles - mostly open ground with sparse structures under ~9 m. The UAV (~26 m altitude) therefore has near line-of-sight to the ground users, which is why Sionna reports high coverage. The wide crop shows where the operating region sits relative to the city.

damage_labels.reason: sionna/scenes/damage_labels.geojson uses a different, unaligned coordinate frame (values around 1500, -475). It is not projected onto this scene - no faked overlay.

channel_model_note: This geometry drives Sionna RT ray tracing (propagation / radio analysis). NS-3 uses its own Wi-Fi channel model for network / MAC / traffic validation and does not consume Sionna's ray-traced channel loss.
